phase_name: Canonical index-entry write with 1:1 chunk children (Decisions B + C)

objectives.description: Rewrite Step 4 to emit canonical parent entry
Emit one child entry per chunks.json row

approaches_tried.approach: Set parent token_count to the document total (literal plan wording)
approaches_tried.reason: Discovered by execution: literature-briefing.sh's chunk_count>0 branch computes total_tokens = sum(children.token_count) + parent.token_count. A non-zero document-total parent token_count double-counts (briefing would report 2676 tokens for a 1338-token fixture). Reverted to token_count=0 for the parent, matching the corpus's own established precedent at commit e6ce8bd9 (baier_katoen_2008/vardi_wolper_1986 parent entries), whose commit message explicitly documents this exact rationale.

deviations.reason: Verified by execution that literature-briefing.sh double-counts when a parent with children carries a non-zero token_count (sums children's token_count and adds the parent's on top). Corpus commit e6ce8bd9 already discovered and fixed this exact issue by setting parent token_count to 0 for its two newly-added parent entries, with a commit message stating the rationale explicitly. Followed the same established, execution-verified convention rather than the plan's literal 'document total' wording, which would reintroduce the double-count.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — token_count set to 0, not document total; see phase notes)*

verification_evidence.end_to_end_fixture: 6-page synthetic fixture PDF ingested into a scratch LITERATURE_DIR. Resulting index.json: exactly 1 parent entry (.id == doc_id, parent_doc == null) and exactly 6 child entries (parent_doc == doc_id), matching chunk_count.
verification_evidence.toc_matches_children: literature-search.sh --toc phase5_fixture_doc returns 6 chunks; index child count is 6. Equal by construction.
verification_evidence.briefing_zero_skip_zero_double_count: literature-briefing-invoke.sh (per-repo mode, symlink fixture) resolves the document with zero skip warnings and reports '6 chunk(s), ~1338 tokens' -- matches --toc's own token sum (1338) exactly, confirming the token_count=0 parent choice avoids double-counting.
verification_evidence.project_filtered_search: literature-search.sh --project Phase5Test --include-unverified 'bisimulation' returns phase5_fixture_doc (--include-unverified required because a freshly-ingested doc has no provenance_fidelity stamp yet and fails open to unverified_summary, which do_search quarantines from default ranking by design -- unrelated to this fix, and exactly the mechanism Decision A's 'switches on fidelity stamping for free' rationale describes).
verification_evidence.idempotent_reingest: Re-ran the same fixture ingest a second time: index.json entry count for this doc_id unchanged (7: 1 parent + 6 children) both before and after -- no duplicate parent, no orphaned children.
verification_evidence.entry_count_delta_note: Fixture measured delta: 1 document -> 7 entries (1 parent + 6 children). Real-world worst case already measured in the plan's own Overview/Phase-1 baseline: baier_katoen_2008 has 1263 FTS chunks; a script-driven 1:1 ingest of a document that size would add ~1264 entries. Not re-ingested here (would require re-processing an entire real book, infeasible within this phase's scope); the plan's Risk table already accepts this as 'entry count grows but the file stays JSON-manageable.'
